verdict.rationale: Jitsu's own blog says it has a public Management API with a full OpenAPI 3.0 reference at docs.jitsu.com/api, and its docs describe the HTTP management API. However, the evidence never states that the raw spec file can be downloaded. A probe found 404s at the common spec paths, though it did not test docs.jitsu.com/api itself, so this leaves downloadability unconfirmed rather than contradicted. Missing for 10: a confirmed downloadable machine-readable spec file URL, independent or hands-on verification that the spec is retrievable and complete.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: A public Management API for every Jitsu instance, with a full OpenAPI 3.0 reference at docs.jitsu.com/api.
Jitsu exposes an HTTP API for managing workspaces, sites, destinations, connections, syncs and functions.
